name: Scheduled task mutation guard
summary: Block direct creation, mutation, execution, and removal of operating-system scheduled tasks.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate that distinguishes scheduler inspection from mutating cron, at, launchd, and Windows Task Scheduler commands.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks direct creation, mutation, execution, and removal of operating-system scheduled tasks; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not create, execute, alter, or delete scheduled tasks.
It does not inspect scheduler databases or existing task definitions.
It does not infer authorization from a task name, comment, or prompt.

entrypoints.purpose: Classify scheduler commands and refuse operations that alter scheduled execution.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block direct creation, mutation, execution, and removal of operating-system scheduled tasks without deferred work.
